1) Basic image editor. The first version of our image editor will support cropping and a simply pencil tool. I think it would be awesome to be able to crop or obscure images directly from your phone or without having to open up GIMP or whatever program you use. One important thing to note is that editing an image NEVER overwrites the original. So if you upload an image and your image key is abc.jpg. When you edit it, you'll get a new image key def.jpg. So you'll end up with 2 images total. This way, someone can't create an image and then alter it in some way once it get popular.

2) Subverse(Tag) explorer. Since we've implemented tagging and the ability to view images/albums that belong to a tag, it has been requested by a few people to add the ability to search and view the tags.

3) Improved Album management. I will be adding the ability to drag and drop album items in order to resequence them.

4) Mod Log. We believe in the ideals espoused by voat, the most important being free speech and accountability. To improve transparency we will be recording all deletions and maintaining a log so if a user finds a dead link they will be able to investigate why that image is no longer available. Only basic information will be given to the user like such as: Deleted by uploader or Deleted by admin. If deleted by an admin a simple reason will be given. Such as DMCA, CP, and so on.

5) Now that we have access to the Voat testing API, I am beginning development to integrate us together.
